scope: disposable VM-shaped ASIF/APFS fixture only; production VM remained running
host_preparation: persistent ~/Library/Application Support/OpenClawRecovery created owner-only on the same host device as the VM image; no production image copied
method: host worker starts while fixture disk is held, waits for an external stop, requires two consistent stopped/no-holder observations, invokes clonefile without a copy fallback, hashes source and clone, extracts four stores read-only, rechecks stopped state and image bytes

guest_fixture.positive: four marker stores extracted; sampled final VM state stopped
guest_fixture.negative: no shutdown before deadline wrote FAILED.json and no clone or CAPTURE.json

host_fixture.positive: four marker stores extracted; sampled final VM state stopped
host_fixture.negative: no shutdown before deadline wrote FAILED.json and no clone or CAPTURE.json

unverified: uninterrupted stopped/no-holder interval rather than sampled observations
